notes.title: RTS Fest Patch: Defend, Survive, and Conquer in the New Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone, 👋[/b]
We’re excited to bring you another thrilling update just in time for the Steam RTS Fest! This patch introduces [b]brand-new gameplay features[/b], several [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b], and some much-needed [b]bug fixes[/b]. Dive in and explore what’s new in *Smelogs Playground*!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41419691/4d66087d8d7c078bac0b47feffa215a2aa200dd0.png[/img]
[h1]🆕 New Features[/h1]  
[b]Aztec Horde: Singleplayer Wave Defend Mode[/b]  
Prepare to face the ultimate challenge in this [b]brand-new game mode[/b]!  
*Brace yourself as waves of relentless enemies close in. With each wave, the challenge intensifies—but so do your skills! Defend, survive, and unlock powerful abilities to crush the horde. How long can you hold your ground?*  

This is the [b]first version[/b], and we’d love to hear your feedback. Let us know what you think!  

[b]AI Unlock Tree[/b]  
Progression just got more exciting! This system allows you to unlock [b]different AI difficulties and strategies[/b], offering:  
- [b]More variety[/b] in gameplay  
- A sense of [b]achievement and progression[/b]  
- The ability to [b]experiment with new AI tactics[/b]  

[h1]Improvements[/h1]  
[list]  
[*] Tog and Trap improved unblocking on upgrade  
[*] Automatic upgrade cancelation if blocked by a map obstacle for Cave or Menhir  
[*] [b]Select All units[/b] functionality refined:  
    - Will no longer select Base Smelogs  
[*] Prevented larger buildings from upgrading when blocked by the map  
[*] Custom Games now support [b]up to 16 Spectators[/b]  
[*] Various improvements to the [b]Replay and Spectator HUD[/b]  
[*] General performance improvements  
[/list]  
[h1]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h1]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed double-click checks when a different key was pressed in between  
[*] Resolved hotkeys not displaying the first time playing  
[*] AI no longer starts before the match begins  
[*] Tutorial progression issues fixed  
[/list]  
[h1]🧪 Testing[/h1]  
[list]  
[*] Aztec Horde game mode  
[*] AI difficulty and strategy unlock tree  
[/list]  

[b]🔍 Found a Bug? Report it! 🐞🤓👍[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Report bugs directly in-game  
[*] Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/PZyhM94JSC]Discord[/url]  
[*] Or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1799530/discussions/0/3815166265394226884/]post here on Steam[/url]  
[/list]  

[b]Happy gaming, and enjoy the RTS Fest! 🙂[/b]

notes.title: 🛠️ PATCH NOTES - 13th September 2024
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]
We've had a super productive two weeks and made a ton of improvements!

[b]AI Love[/b]
The AI got some love and is way smarter now – you should notice a big difference in how it behaves.

[b]HUD Updates[/b]
We’ve added new, easy-to-use ability buttons on the HUD and gave the radial movement menu a fresh new look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41419691/d8daad66f0c78585d6c76d79abcaa0595030f2ec.png[/img]
[b]Steam Achievements[/b]
Steam Achievements are here! 😁 We're not 100% happy with some of them yet, so they might change, and we’re planning to add more in the future, so stay tuned!

[b]New Hotkeys[/b]
New hotkeys are in place to make it easier to select Smelogs and filter through them.

[b]Trap Damage Adjustment[/b]
We adjusted trap damage since unit avoidance and collision are still turned off so traps were way too strong for now, so we toned them down a bit.



[b]Full List of Changes:[/b]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Hotkey: Select all of type on screen
[*] Setting to disable double-click selecting all of type on screen
[*] Version mismatch indicator to notify players to update Smelogs Playground
[*] Guardian Strike now shows in post-match results under Crystal Codex spell history
[*] New Ability HUD buttons (can be turned off in Settings under Controls)
[*] Movement Order input mode can now switch between hold and toggle (Settings > Controls)
[*] Post Match Line Graph now displays player values
[*] Visual update to the radial movement order menu
[*] AI behavior improvements
[*] Filter selection for low health and damaged units
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Behavior Warning UI popped up after a match
[*] Matchmaking now pairs players with the same game version
[*] Hosts no longer see pings from other teams
[*] Guardian Strike can’t be cast while the game is paused anymore
[*] Fixed issue where learning spells in the Spell Tree was possible while paused
[*] Mouse hotkeys now work properly with modifier keys
[*] You can now set a hotkey to none
[*] Emotes display correctly now
[*] AI can now spawn Tog and Trap spells properly
[*] AI can produce the next squad as intended
[*] Overcharge indicator now shows for Menhir when using a skinset
[*] Unit Evade no longer cancels other movement orders
[*] Units now follow new orders correctly after finishing the previous one
[*] Fixed trap not dealing damage to Molten Golem
[/list]

[h1]Testing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Steam Achievements are live for testing!
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Trap damage adjusted: 100 >>> 75
[/list]


[b]🔍 Found a Bug 🐞 report it 🤓👍[/b]
[list]
[*] You can report bugs directly in-game
[*] On [url=https://discord.gg/PZyhM94JSC]Discord[/url]
[*] Or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1799530/discussions/0/3815166265394226884/]here on Steam[/url] where you also can see a list of known bugs.
[/list]

[b]That’s it for now! Thanks for all the support, and let us know what you think![/b]

notes.title: 🛠️ PATCH NOTES - 19th July 2024
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone[/b]
After a while, we are finally ready with a new Patch with improvements and bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience! This update introduces new building spot indicators, crucial bug fixes, and several UI enhancements. Plus, we've made some balancing changes to improve 2vs2 matches and adjusted the health of specific units. Dive into the details below and see what's new!

Here is the full list of updates:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Massive performance gains
[*] Improved visuals for the Crystal Codex Spell to make it more readable and to better indicate learned and unlearned spells.
[*] Various other UI updates
[*] Quieter startup video
[*] Subtle adjacent cave and menhir building spot indicators
[*] New base spawning locations
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Pansies would only spawn close to the center or in the corners. They will now spawn more evenly across the map.
[/list]
[h1]Testing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Buildup helper for beginners can be turned on in the controls
[*] Menhir 20 production queue cap
[/list]
[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] 2vs2 Match Adjustments: In response to feedback about the difficulty in defending against hyper rushes targeting a single player, teammates will now spawn in the same color adjacent to each other. This change aims to facilitate teamwork and make it easier for teammates to assist and defend each other.
[*] Ranged Smelog health reduced from 200 >>> 160
[*] Baller health reduced from 140 >>> 130
[/list]

[u]Note:[/u] Unit avoidance will remain turned off in this patch.


[b]🔍 Found a Bug 🐞 report it 🤓👍[/b]
[list]
[*] You can report bugs directly in-game
[*] On [url=https://discord.gg/PZyhM94JSC]Discord[/url]
[*] Or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1799530/discussions/0/3815166265394226884/]here on Steam[/url] where you also can see a list of known bugs.
[/list]
[b]Happy Weekend and Enjoy 🙂[/b]

notes.title: 🛠️ PATCH NOTES - 31st May 2024
notes.notes:
[b]Hey, the new Patch is live 🙌[/b]
If your game crashed while loading into the map, this issue is now resolved.
We fixed issues with units getting blocked inside buildings and being unable to reach certain areas. You can now change the camera panning to the WASD keys by going to Settings > Hotkeys and selecting the WASD camera preset. 

Here is the full list of updates:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Party and Invite UI adjusted
[*] A better more noticeable Custom Game leave button added
[*] Enter Cave hover indicator
[*] Profile and Match Result Base Layouts now display unit preview images
[*] Custom games with only 2 players will now default to all chat
[*] Performance
[*] Added Tool Tips for Item types
[*] How obstacles are being drawn for the Minimap
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cancel upgrade sound was audible to other players
[*]Voice line "No energy" from Gianni now plays in stereo instead of mono
[*]Line graph would not display post-match if a spectator was in the game
[*]Units being stuck in buildings
[*]Units unable to reach some areas
[/list]

[h1]Testing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tutorial changes
[*] WASD for Camera control hotkey preset
[/list]
